description: This file declares functions and includes for radio MAC configuration within a wireless device driver or system. It defines functions for generating MAC addresses and configuring radio interfaces, with licensing and include guards.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_shiftMbssIfNotEnoughVaps
methods.description: Adjusts MBSS interfaces if there are not enough virtual access points.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_updateRadBaseMac
methods.description: Updates the base MAC address for the radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_generateEpMac
methods.description: Generates an Ethernet port MAC address for the radio interface.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_generateBssid
methods.description: Generates a BSSID MAC address for the radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_generateDummyBssid
methods.description: Generates a dummy BSSID MAC address.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_hasShiftedMbssBaseMac
methods.description: Checks if the MBSS base MAC has been shifted.
